commands.name: add
commands.help: Bring one or more stack modules into the workspace, with what they need.

params.name: modules
params.help: Modules to bring in: sushiruntime | sushiengine | sushiai | sushiblas | all.

params.name: dry_run
params.help: Show, don't clone or install.

params.name: skip_install
params.help: Do not run the dependency install afterwards.

params.name: binary
params.help: Install sushiengine from its release even when its source is in reach.

commands.name: doctor
commands.help: Inventory tools, compilers, and dependencies; report what is missing.

commands.name: gui build
commands.help: Configure and compile the desktop application.

params.name: build_type
params.help: The configuration to build.

params.name: clean
params.help: Remove the build tree before configuring.

params.name: define
params.help: Extra cmake cache entry; repeatable.

commands.name: gui clean
commands.help: Remove the desktop application's build tree.

commands.name: gui run
commands.help: Launch a program the desktop application's build tree holds.

params.name: target
params.help: Executable to launch; the application itself when omitted.

commands.name: gui test
commands.help: Run the desktop application's tests through CTest.

params.name: filter
params.help: Run only the tests whose name matches this pattern.

params.name: repeat
params.help: Re-run each test until it fails or this many runs pass.

commands.name: home
commands.help: Print the resolved workspace root and dependency directory.

commands.name: init
commands.help: Turn the current directory into a SushiStack workspace.

commands.name: install
commands.help: Provision the shared dependencies into the workspace's dependencies/ tree.

params.name: customize
params.help: Pick which components to install in an interactive TUI instead of what the present modules declare.

params.name: dry_run
params.help: Show, don't change.

params.name: yes
params.help: Assume yes on the LLVM-download prompt, for unattended runs.

params.name: refresh_toolchains
params.help: Re-download the SYCL toolchain even if one is already installed.

commands.name: install-cli
commands.help: Install a module's developer CLI into an isolated pipx venv.

params.name: modules
params.help: Modules whose CLI to install: sushiruntime | sushiengine | sushiai | sushiblas | all.

params.name: dry_run
params.help: Show, don't install.

commands.name: license
commands.help: Print the licences the signed-in Sushi Account holds.

commands.name: link
commands.help: Register an existing checkout (outside the workspace) as a module.

params.name: module
params.help: Module name: sushiruntime | sushiengine | sushiai | sushiblas.

params.name: path
params.help: Path to an existing checkout of that module.

params.name: dry_run
params.help: Show, don't write the link.

params.name: skip_install
params.help: Do not run the dependency install afterwards.

commands.name: login
commands.help: Sign in to Sushi Account and keep the session in the credential store.

commands.name: logout
commands.help: Forget the stored Sushi Account session on this machine.

commands.name: remove
commands.help: Remove provisioned dependencies. Use --all to reclaim the lot.

params.name: all
params.help: Wipe everything: vcpkg ports, downloaded toolchains (intel/llvm + AdaptiveCpp + oneAPI, several GB), and the portable cmake/ninja — the whole dependencies/ tree.

params.name: gpu
params.help: Include GPU-only deps in removal.

params.name: dry_run
params.help: Show what would be removed.

params.name: yes
params.help: Skip the confirmation prompt for --all.

commands.name: status
commands.help: Show which modules are cloned and whether dependencies are present.

params.name: json_output
params.help: Print machine-readable JSON instead of a table.

params.name: check_updates
params.help: Fetch every checkout and ask Sushi Account for newer releases first.

commands.name: sync
commands.help: Bring the workspace up to date: install missing deps, then update modules.

params.name: dry_run
params.help: Show, don't change.

commands.name: update
commands.help: Bring the workspace and every present module up to date.

params.name: modules
params.help: Modules to update (omit for all present modules).

params.name: dry_run
params.help: Show, don't pull.

commands.name: whoami
commands.help: Print the Sushi Account this machine is signed in as.
